decisions.reason: Correctly distinguishes clipboard-text draft/Occurrence coordinates (chip = full clipboardText) from detect coordinates used by insertReference/consumeToken (chip = one U+FFFC), citing contract and facade; notes plain text and spaces are 1:1.

Locates snapshot.draft.length in add(); explains empty-composer coincidence, then overshoot by length-1 making the detect splice out of range, insertReference returning false, plugin showing its changed-composer toast; explicitly rejects a real concurrent edit.

Traces remove(): unconverted occurrence span to consumeToken, ignored false result, unconditional records.delete, live occurrence plus missing record rendering unavailable; ties both symptoms to the same coordinate mismatch.

Derives subtract-sum-of(length-1) mapping, applies at both call sites (all occurrences for end-of-draft insert; mapped offset plus one-detect-char span for removal), keeps the revision guard, gates records.delete on consumeToken success, and assesses the clipboard-coordinate fallback.

Proposes two then three successive pastes with all chips asserted, removal of first and second of two chips asserting composer occurrence, dock chip and record removed together while the other chip survives; adds declined-consumption and typed-text variants.
